# Smart Environment Group

> Property developer, design-and-build contractor and property maintenance company for London and the Home Counties, trading since 2009. One group covers development, construction and ongoing property services.

- Trading name: Smart Environment Group (also known as SEUK). Three divisions: Development, Construction and Property Services.
- Legal entity: Smart Environment Property Developments Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 10469032.
- Office: 720 Centennial Court, Centennial Park, Elstree WD6 3SY, United Kingdom.
- Phone: +44 20 8163 4044. Email: info@seukltd.com. Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 18:00.
- Trading since 2009. Area: London, Hertfordshire and the Home Counties, with selected projects elsewhere in the UK.
- Accreditation: SSIP-recognised PQS Health and Safety Approved (valid to July 2027).
- Track record: more than 460 responsive repairs for housing associations between 2023 and 2026, across seven housing associations and co-operatives.

## The three divisions
- [Property Development](https://seukltd.com/property-development/): the group's own schemes and joint ventures, including Prestige House in Catford and licensed HMOs in Hampstead and Acton.
- [Construction](https://seukltd.com/construction/): design and build, conversions, refurbishment, basements and rooftop extensions for developers, asset managers and private owners.
- [Property Services](https://seukltd.com/property-services/): responsive repairs, small works and planned maintenance for housing associations, managing agents and landlords. 463 repair jobs between January 2023 and September 2026 for seven housing associations and co-operatives, rated 4.5 out of 5 from 156 client reviews on the Plentific platform.

## What the company does
- [Property development](https://seukltd.com/services/property-development-london-home-counties/): acquisition advice, planning, design coordination and delivery of residential, commercial and mixed-use schemes.
- [Design and build construction](https://seukltd.com/services/design-build-contractor-london/): new builds, refurbishments, basements, extensions, rooftop and loft work.
- [HMO and student accommodation conversions](https://seukltd.com/services/student-accommodation-hmo-conversion/): layouts, fire safety, licensing standards and building control sign-off.
- [Commercial refurbishment](https://seukltd.com/services/commercial-refurbishment-london/) and [mixed-use development](https://seukltd.com/services/commercial-mixed-use-development-london/).
- [MEP, electrical and HVAC](https://seukltd.com/services/mep-electrical-hvac-contractor-london/) and [smart building systems](https://seukltd.com/services/smart-building-automation-london/).
- [Planned and reactive maintenance](https://seukltd.com/services/planned-reactive-maintenance/) for landlords, managing agents and housing associations.

## Projects with photo galleries
- [Prestige House: nine new apartments, Catford SE6](https://seukltd.com/projects/prestige-house-catford/): Comprehensive demolition and redevelopment of a former gas reduction facility, transforming the site from a single national utility structure into Prestige House, a collection of nine high-specification apartments (five one-bedroom and four two-bedroom) in Catford, South London.
- [Rooftop extension: four new penthouses, Cricklewood NW2](https://seukltd.com/projects/rooftop-penthouses-cricklewood/): Construction of 4 new penthouse flats on the roof of a 24-flat 1930s mansion block in Cricklewood, with all residents in occupation throughout.
- [Nine-bedroom HMO conversion, Hampstead NW3](https://seukltd.com/projects/hmo-conversion-hampstead/): Victorian property on Finchley Road, Hampstead, converted into a high-specification nine-bedroom HMO, combining original character with modern living standards.
- [Six-bedroom HMO conversion, Acton W3](https://seukltd.com/projects/hmo-conversion-acton/): Conversion and full refurbishment of a property in Acton, West London, into a high-specification licensed six-bedroom HMO.
- [Mercia Lodge: 19 student rooms, Coventry](https://seukltd.com/projects/student-accommodation-coventry/): Design and build conversion of the unused second floor of a former Travelodge hotel in Coventry city centre into 19 self-contained student rooms, taking the building to 169 rooms.
